# Florida Security Concepts

Florida Security Concepts LLC repairs, maintains, and installs gates, access control, and cameras for commercial and residential properties. Based in Clermont, Lake County. Same-day when available.

Phone: 352-282-0692
Email: info@floridasecurityconcepts.com
Website: https://www.floridasecurityconcepts.com

## Services

- Security gate systems: slide, swing, barrier-arm, and vertical-lift gates
- Gate repair
- Gate automation and operators
- Maintenance plans, with the visit frequency set per site
- Access control: keypads, credentials, call boxes, and intercoms
- Video surveillance of the lane, the vehicle, and the gate
- Security system integration
- Emergency service, available after hours. Call 352-282-0692. Same-day when available. The website form does not dispatch a technician.

An advanced consultation is the way to talk through a property. Submitting the form does not book a visit.

## Service areas

Scheduled from Clermont, Lake County:

- Orlando
- Kissimmee
- Winter Garden
- Clermont
- Tampa Bay, including Tampa, St. Petersburg, Clearwater, Brandon, and Wesley Chapel
- Lakeland
- Ocala

## Properties

HOAs, community development districts (CDDs), gated communities, multifamily, self-storage, commercial, industrial, property managers, and estates.
